'''Clube Desportivo Cova da Piedade''' is a [[association football|football]] club established in the parish of [[Cova da Piedade]], municipality of [[Almada]], Portugal. The club merged with [[B-SAD]], in an attempt of the former to retain their position currently in [[Liga 3 (Portugal)|Liga 3]], the third tier of Portuguese football, but they weren't granted license and were relegated to distrital championships.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-3/b-sad/detalhe/oficial-cova-da-piedade-fora-das-competicoes-da-fpf | title=Oficial: Cova da Piedade fora das competições da FPF }}</ref>"}}
